requirement.final_inclusive_alpha: round(255*j/35), j=0..35; last frame full CREAM
requirement.intro_alpha: round(255*(1-frame/18)), frame0..17; first outside frame18 unfaded
requirement.source: Accepted timeline durations and explicitly approved inclusive final endpoint; no renderer function imported

patch_scope: Native opaque stable red curtains, side floor and upper paper trim; exclude characters, numbers, text and transparent margins.
regression: P = B + alpha*(C-B); least-squares over native RGB patch pixels. B is independently decoded unfaded intro/outro; C is decoded first frame, checked against authored CREAM(255,249,234).

codec_tolerance.per_patch_alpha_levels: 255 * 4 / RMS(decoded_CREAM - decoded_unfaded_patch); propagation of unchanged4RGB tolerance

unfaded_final_tail.kind: analysis-only baseline substitution; no production movie changed

scope: Decoded native MP4 fade/background pixels and two negative controls only; actor/text content and audio reviewed separately.
